spec.claim_summary: A Bitcoin strategy buys when Trend Score and Relative Trend Score exceed 7 at a 10-day closing high and exits when Trend Score falls below 5.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical rule can be recovered because entry and exit depend on proprietary Trend Score and Relative Trend Score values with no defined calculation.

claimed.other: average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%

assumptions: Assets mapped Bitcoin to BTCUSDT spot; no other asset named.
Timeframe 1d chosen from page chart timeframe; claim text states no timeframe.
Direction long inferred from buy signals; shorts never mentioned.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Bitcoin Trend Score (>7 entry, <5 exit) and Bitcoin Relative Trend Score (>7 entry) are proprietary undefined scores with no equivalent indicator; they are omitted and the remaining 10-day-high breakout alone is not the claimed system.
Entry 10-day high encoded as close gt highest_high(10) per breakout rule; no mechanical exit recoverable because the only stated exit uses the proprietary Trend Score.
Claimed period start 2011-01-01 interprets 'Since 2011' as calendar-year start.

evidence.quote: average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%
